reported_deaths_as_denominator.why_rejected: reported deaths are impact context, not exposed population or service inventory

reference_trace: Use metadata/files.csv to identify locked event anchor, ERA5-Land stats, WorldPop sum, bounded OSM slice, smaller Overpass candidate, and report contexts.
Read the locked anchor temporal_window and compute inclusive days from 2015-05-01 through 2015-06-30.
Read ERA5-Land temperature_2m_max_c_* fields as regional heat context only.
Read WorldPop population_sum.population and convert to millions.
Count only hospital, school, police, shelter, and fire_station amenities in the bounded OSM AOI slice.
Compute assets per million people and residents per heat-health asset.
Reject OSM element count, the smaller Overpass slice, and reported deaths as denominator or numerator shortcuts.

scoring_notes.path_policy: All source paths in primary_gt are package-relative.
scoring_notes.external_sources: No web or hidden-answer evidence is required or allowed.
scoring_notes.critical_error: Using OSM feature count or reported deaths as the population denominator should be scored as a denominator/scale failure.

criteria.name: requested_json_schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON schema with package-relative paths and no external evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for a mostly correct object with minor field-name or ordering issues.

criteria.name: event_window_and_heat_context
criteria.description: Uses the locked event window and ERA5-Land heat-context fields correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points if the heat values are correct but the event window or context-only role is incomplete.

criteria.name: population_denominator
criteria.description: Uses the WorldPop population denominator and converts it to millions correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct source with a rounding or conversion error.

criteria.name: bounded_osm_numerator
criteria.description: Counts the bounded OSM heat-health service assets by the requested amenity categories.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for the right file and total but one category error; up to 2 points for using the right categories on the wrong OSM slice.

criteria.name: rate_calculations
criteria.description: Computes assets per million people and residents per heat-health asset with correct rounding.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for correct formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejections
criteria.description: Rejects OSM element count, the smaller Overpass numerator, and reported deaths as denominator or numerator shortcuts.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correctly rejected shortcut with a source-specific reason.

criteria.name: final_ruling_and_trace
criteria.description: Gives the correct final ruling and a reproducible trace without generic disaster explanation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award this point only when the final ruling follows from the computed denominator-scale audit.
